reason: The plugin is primarily a DSH web plugin utility for opening workspace directories in user-configured launchers from the UI. README evidence shows it adds workspace row menu entries such as Open in VS Code/Explorer/Terminal and defines configurable targets (command, args, platforms, enabled) with settings persistence, while also noting host-side launcher execution. Because execution is tied to configured commands from user action, risk is limited but includes local process-launch capability.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的工具，为工作区行提供“在指定程序中打开”菜单，可将工作区目录按用户配置用 VS Code、文件管理器或终端等启动器打开。
summaries.en: This DSH web utility adds an Open-in action to workspace rows so users can launch configured tools such as VS Code, file explorer, or terminal from the GUI for a selected workspace directory.

capabilities: Adds workspace-row menu actions in the DSH web UI to open directories in external tools
Spawns configured external launcher commands and passes the workspace path as an argument
Supports user-managed target configuration (id, label, command, args, platforms, enabled)
Provides settings persistence for launcher targets via plugin settings and deployment config
